'''2000 Boston Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner was to receive a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 8 April 2000<ref name="tr-d496" />
* '''Site:''' Boston, Massachusetts
* '''Players:''' 40<ref name="tr-d494" />

Decipher lists the Star Trek CCG winner as Jason Petkus and the Young Jedi winner as Larry Plano.<ref name="gs00" />

=== Location discrepancy ===
[[Paul Maholick]]'s tournament report ([[Paul Maholick Milford Mass Grand Slam 4-8-00 (tournament report)|report]]) places this Grand Slam in Milford, Massachusetts, on 8 April 2000, with 40 players.<ref name="tr-d494" /> Decipher's Grand Slam 2000 list names it Boston.<ref name="gs00" /> It is the only Massachusetts Grand Slam of April 2000, so the report is filed here; until there is more evidence the wiki keeps Decipher's name.

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Paul Maholick Milford Mass Grand Slam 4-8-00 (tournament report)]] — by [[Paul Maholick]], 11th, 4–2
* [[Michael Hawley Kashyyyk Grand Slam 04-08-2000 (tournament report)]] — by [[Michael Hawley]], 8th, 4–2

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Paul Maholick's report places this Grand Slam in Milford, Massachusetts, on 8 April 2000 (40 players); Decipher's Grand Slam 2000 list and the hub name it Boston. It is the only Massachusetts Grand Slam of April 2000, so the report is filed under the Boston hub.<ref name="tr-d494" />
